backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the RENTIQ backend, defining data types and CRUD operations for inventory, challans, payments, petty cash, clients, staff advances, and cash equivalents, with access control and user approval logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking the app initialization flow fix (showing SignInScreen before backend actor init) to its relevant files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON-formatted text file containing short summaries of each frontend source file, describing their purpose and notable changes made during development.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_CHECKLIST.md: Step-by-step deployment and verification guide covering build/deploy commands, a critical inventory add-item test flow, and instructions for using the in-app diagnostics panel.
frontend/index.css: Empty CSS file at the frontend root level.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the RENTIQ frontend, setting up CSP headers, the root div, and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component that shows SignInScreen immediately for unauthenticated users, then wraps authenticated users with BackendConnectionGate and AuthApprovalGate before rendering the full AppRouter with page-based navigation.
frontend/src/components/challans/Challan: Dialog component for bulk uploading challans via CSV, handling file parsing, validation, preview, and submission to the backend with per-row success/failure reporting.
Dialog component for editing an existing challan, with fields for client, venue, site, dates, items, and freight. Locks editing if the challan has been marked as returned.
Dialog component for creating a new challan with auto-generated ID, client selection or creation, site/date/item fields, and inventory validation.
Dialog for bulk uploading challans via CSV in a new format, supporting file parsing, preview, validation, and batch creation through the backend.
Admin-only dialog for restoring challan rent and return dates by uploading a CSV file, with parse error display and success confirmation.
frontend/src/components/clients/ClientBu: Dialog for bulk uploading clients via CSV, with template download, file parsing, preview, validation against existing clients, and batch creation.
frontend/src/components/common/AppErrorB: React class-based error boundary that catches rendering errors and displays a fallback UI with an error message and a page reload button.
frontend/src/components/common/ApprovalR: Displays a full-screen card for users whose accounts are pending admin approval, allowing them to request access or sign out.
frontend/src/components/common/AuthAppro: Gate component that checks approval/admin status and either renders children, a loading skeleton, or the ApprovalRequiredScreen based on the user's state.
frontend/src/components/common/BackendCo: Gate component that shows a loading spinner while the backend actor is initializing, then renders children once connected.
frontend/src/components/common/BuildInfo: Collapsible debug panel showing backend connection status with buttons to run a health check and copy a diagnostics report to the clipboard.
frontend/src/components/common/BulkUploa: Collection of reusable UI sub-components (steps guide, template download, validation button, preview/error summary) for bulk CSV upload workflows.
frontend/src/components/common/Diagnosti: Modal dialog that displays the formatted diagnostics report in a read-only textarea with options to copy it to the clipboard or clear the log.
frontend/src/components/common/ModalSele: Thin wrapper around Shadcn's SelectContent that sets a high z-index and stops wheel-event propagation for correct behavior inside modals.
frontend/src/components/common/QueryErro: Reusable error alert component for query failures that shows a classified message, collapsible troubleshooting steps, and expandable technical details with retry/sign-in actions.
frontend/src/components/common/SignInReq: Modal dialog prompting unauthenticated users to sign in via Internet Identity before performing a restricted action.
frontend/src/components/common/SignInScr: Full-screen sign-in page displaying the RentIQ branding and an Internet Identity login button with a loading state.
frontend/src/components/inventory/Invent: A dialog component for bulk uploading inventory items via CSV file, with parsing, validation, preview, and error reporting before submitting to the backend.
A dialog form component for adding or editing a single inventory item, with validation for name uniqueness, quantity, and daily rate.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: The main application layout component providing a responsive sidebar navigation with role-based admin links, user identity display, and logout functionality.
frontend/src/components/payments/Payment: A dialog component for bulk uploading payments via CSV, handling file parsing, validation, preview, and submission to the backend with result reporting.
A dialog form component for adding a single payment record, with fields for date, client, payment mode, amount, reference number, and site.
frontend/src/components/petty-cash/Petty: React component that manages file attachments (PNG, JPG, PDF up to 10MB) for a petty cash record identified by date, supporting upload and removal via query hooks.
Dialog component for bulk-importing petty cash records from a CSV file, with parsing/validation, error display, and upload results summary.
Dialog form for adding or editing a single petty cash record, auto-calculating cash received from payments and closing balance, with print and attachment support.
frontend/src/hooks/useAccessManagement.t: React Query hooks for admin access management: checking admin status, listing approvals, setting approval status, and categorizing users by pending/approved/rejected.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActorWithConnectio: Thin wrapper around useActor that exposes a simplified connection status interface (idle/connecting/ready/failed) with stub diagnostics and retry fields.
frontend/src/hooks/useAppMode.ts: Hook that determines whether the app is running in admin mode by checking if the hostname contains '-x18' or is localhost.
frontend/src/hooks/useApprovalStatus.ts: React Query hooks for checking caller approval/admin status, requesting approval, setting approval for a user, and listing all approvals.
frontend/src/hooks/useBootstrapAdmin.ts: Mutation hook that verifies admin status and invalidates approval-related queries after the bootstrap process handled in useActor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout state and persisting identity across page reloads using DFINITY's AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useMutationGate.ts: Hook that checks whether the app is ready to perform mutations by verifying actor availability and authentication status, returning readiness flags and descriptive messages.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks for fetching and mutating backend data (clients, inventory, challans, payments, petty cash), each invalidating relevant query caches on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueryDataVersion.t: Hook that derives a serializable version string from React Query cache metadata (dataUpdatedAt) to avoid BigInt serialization errors in dependent query keys.
Hook that determines whether the current user is subject to staff restrictions (no bulk upload or delete) based on app mode and admin status.
frontend/src/hooks/useTodayKey.ts: Hook that returns a stable YYYY-MM-DD date string and automatically updates it at midnight to trigger date-aware query invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports fonts, configures Tailwind, defines CSS custom properties for light/dark themes, and adds print and scrollbar styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
Admin page for managing user access approvals, displaying pending/approved/rejected principals and allowing admins to approve, deny, revoke, or re-approve users.
frontend/src/pages/ChallanDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed view of a single challan including items, dates, and totals, with actions to edit, delete, mark as returned, and print.
frontend/src/pages/ChallanPrintPage.tsx: Renders a print-friendly challan layout and automatically triggers the browser print dialog after the data loads.
frontend/src/pages/ChallansPage.tsx: Lists all challans with search/filter, and provides actions to create, edit, delete, mark returned, and bulk-upload challans.
frontend/src/pages/ClientBalancesPage.ts: Shows a summary table of per-client outstanding and advance balances derived from challans and payments.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Displays key business metrics (challan counts, rent totals, payments, pending amounts) grouped by time period using cards and skeleton loading states.
frontend/src/pages/InventoryPage.tsx: Lists inventory items with quantities and daily rates, and supports adding, editing, deleting, and bulk-uploading items with staff-restricted controls.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentsPage.tsx: Displays a paginated, sortable table of payment records with add and bulk-upload actions, using staff restriction hooks to conditionally show controls.
frontend/src/pages/PettyCashPage.tsx: Renders a petty cash records table with add, edit, delete, and bulk-upload functionality, respecting staff permission restrictions.
frontend/src/pages/ReportsPage.tsx: Provides a tabbed reports view over challans, payments, and petty cash with date, client, site, and status filters plus Excel export support.
frontend/src/utils/challanExportTemplate: Builds item-level worksheet data arrays for challan Excel exports, repeating challan-level fields per item row and matching a fixed template header.
frontend/src/utils/challanImport.ts: Parses a legacy CSV format for challan bulk imports, validating required columns and field values and returning structured Challan objects with errors.
frontend/src/utils/challanImportNewForma: Parses a newer challan CSV format where items are encoded as tokens (colon or parentheses syntax) in a single column, converting rows into Challan objects with validation errors.
Parses and validates a CSV file for challan date restoration, supporting both legacy (Start Date/End Date) and new (Rent Date/Return Date) column formats, and returns valid Challan objects along with row-level errors.
frontend/src/utils/challanTotals.ts: Provides utility functions to calculate totals for individual challan items (quantity × rate × rentalDays) and full challans (items total + freight).
frontend/src/utils/clientImport.ts: Parses a CSV file of client names and validates each row against existing clients, returning valid Client objects and row-level errors for duplicates or missing names.
frontend/src/utils/csv.ts: A CSV parsing utility that handles standard quoting rules, escaped quotes, multi-line fields, UTF-8 BOM, and CRLF line endings, returning parsed headers and rows.
frontend/src/utils/dashboardMetrics.ts: Calculates dashboard metrics (challan count, rent totals, cash/online received, pending amounts) for daily, monthly, all-time, and future periods from challans and payments data.
frontend/src/utils/dates.ts: Provides date utility functions including nanosecond bigint conversion, formatting, parsing multiple date string formats, and rental day calculations.
frontend/src/utils/diagnosticsReport.ts: Collects and formats a diagnostics report including browser info, Internet Identity auth events, backend connection probe statistics, and error logs from the runtime diagnostic log.
frontend/src/utils/errors.ts: Provides error classification utilities that normalize unknown errors into typed categories (e.g., timeout, authorization, connection) with troubleshooting guidance.
frontend/src/utils/exportToCSV.ts: Exports CSV template download functions for inventory, challan (standard and new format), payment, and petty cash bulk upload templates.
frontend/src/utils/exportToExcel.ts: Generates and downloads a multi-sheet Excel report (Summary, Challans, Payments, Petty Cash, Client Balances) using SheetJS loaded dynamically from CDN.
frontend/src/utils/paymentImport.ts: Parses and validates payment CSV files, converting rows into typed Payment objects while checking for duplicate IDs, invalid dates, and missing required fields.
frontend/src/utils/pettyCashImport.ts: Parses and validates petty cash CSV files, mapping columns to PettyCash records, computing net/closing balances, and reporting per-row errors with a preview structure.
frontend/src/utils/pettyCashPdf.ts: Generates and prints a PDF for a PettyCash record using pdf-lib, rendering financial rows (opening balance, expenses, etc.) with formatted currency and dates, then appending any attachment blobs as additional pages.
frontend/src/utils/reportExportFormatter: Provides shared formatting helper functions for Excel report exports, including bigint nanosecond-to-date conversion, currency formatting, safe text normalization, and short date formatting.
frontend/src/utils/runtimeDiagnostics.ts: Implements a runtime diagnostics logger that tracks authentication lifecycle, actor initialization, connection probes, and errors, persisting entries to sessionStorage for troubleshooting deployment and auth failures.
frontend/src/utils/safeSerialize.ts: Provides safe JSON serialization and error formatting utilities that handle BigInt values by converting them to strings, preventing serialization errors in diagnostics and display contexts.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support for sensitive tokens.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the RENTIQ frontend, defining a custom design system with OKLCH-based color tokens, custom fonts (Inter, JetBrains Mono), border radii, and animation keyframes.
project_state.json: Project state metadata for RENTIQ describing its architecture (ICP/Internet Identity, 7 modules), known issues (black screen on load), and pending feature requests focused on fixing the authentication-first initialization flow.
